artifacts.content:
# Impact Planner Accessibility Fix

Outcome: pass

## Context Identity

Verified all nine declared context items against their exact raw SHA-256 digests and byte counts before use. All matched.

## Correction

Updated `examples/impact-planner/src/app.js` so changed-component list rows use `changed-item`, the existing accessible stylesheet selector. Added a focused integration regression test that reads both runtime source and stylesheet, asserts the emitted class is `changed-item`, and asserts the corresponding selector exists in `styles.css`.

## Verification

- `node --test test/integration.test.mjs`: passed 6 of 6 tests.
- `npm.cmd test`: passed 23 of 23 tests.
- `npm.cmd run check`: passed syntax checks for the complete app suite.

Only the declared source and integration-test files were modified.
